text: そろそろ　ばてて　きたんじゃない？

structure.jp: ばてて　きたんじゃない？
structure.en: haven't you started to get worn out?

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て verb shows a change that has been building up until now. ばてて　きた = 'have started getting worn out'.

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.explanation: んじゃない？ is the spoken form of のではないか. It is not a 'no': it means 'isn't it the case that...?', said when you think it is true. ばてて　きたんじゃない？ = 'aren't you getting worn out?'
